title: Sarwar ke azadar
body:
sarwar ke azadar - 6
mazloom ki talwar - 2 sarwar ke azadar
<<DIVIDER>>
hai deen ke madadgar sarwar ke azadar - 2
1. Allah ne jab khalq ke meyaar banaye
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zarf kushada the wo sardar banaye
sardar me kuch sahibe anwaar banaye
<<DIVIDER>>
anwaar tarashe to azadar banaye
Ab jo mere maula ka azadar nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khudse zara soche ke wo bakaar nahi hai
2. Takhleeq ki tarkeeb me hai 4 anaseer
<<DIVIDER>>
sab hai mere maula ke azadar anaseer
is waaste hai sahibe asraar anaseer
<<DIVIDER>>
khud karte hai is baat ka iqraar anaseer
na aag na paani se na mitti se hawa se
<<DIVIDER>>
hum khalq hue fatima zehra ki dua se
3. sach hai ke nazar ho to hate ayb nazar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
mausam to kabhi dekhiye tauheed nagar ka
maghmoom fiza surkh shafaq huzn sahar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kaala hai gilaaf isliye Allah ke ghar ka
tauheed parastaare wali ibne wali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khaaliq bhi azaadare husain ibne ali hai
4. kis zarf ka haamil hai azadar ka sina
<<DIVIDER>>
na bughz na ilhaad na ohaam na kina
hai karbobala ka yaha aabad madina
<<DIVIDER>>
is shehr me dushwaar hai agyaar ka jina
sine pe jo maatam ki ye tehreeq chali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sine me hai dil dil me hussain ibne ali hai
5. hum sino pe maatam se banate hai musalle
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti hai azaan jab to sajate hai musalle
maatam ke julooso me bichaate hai musalle
<<DIVIDER>>
khud apni zubaa se ye batate hai musalle
sajdo me bhi shabbir ko rota hai namazi
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka har matami hota hai namazi
6. uthta hai jo maatam ko azadar ka panja
<<DIVIDER>>
tehzeeb ke sine pe hai afqaar ka panja
5 ungliya hai 5 ke iqraar ka panja
<<DIVIDER>>
har duar me har zulm ke inqaar ka panja
islam ki buniyad ka dhaancha bhi yahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsaare yazidi pe tamacha bhi yahi hai
7. Hubdaar ki aankhon me hai rehmat ke zakhire
<<DIVIDER>>
palko me chupe hai kahi ashko ke jazeere
jab kohe basirat se utarte hai ye hire
<<DIVIDER>>
ho jaate hai tabdil muqaddar ke vatire
sidra se azadar ko aati ye sada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
is jins ka mehshar me kharidar khuda hai
8. Ek ashk se ho jaati hai saason ki taharat
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ashk se buj jaati hai dozakh ki hararat
ek ashk se kar sakte ho jannat ki tijarat
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ashk se hojaati hai maula ki ziyarat
aankhon ko agar rone ki aadat nahi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat me bhi maula ki ziyarat nahi hogi
author: Mir Hassan Mir
